description: React component for a filter popover in the admin console's system users management interface, allowing filtering by team, role, and status.

methods.name: handleTeamFilterChange
methods.description: Handles changes to the team filter, updating the filter state accordingly.

methods.name: handleRoleFilterChange
methods.description: Handles changes to the role filter, updating the filter state accordingly.

methods.name: handleStatusFilterChange
methods.description: Handles changes to the status filter, updating the filter state accordingly.

methods.name: handleApplyFilters
methods.description: Dispatches the filter state to update the user management table and closes the popover.
